speakers.name: Static
speakers.comment: They remember the saves you ABANDONED, folks. Every file you walked away from has been sitting in an 8-bit desert waiting for the signal to come back on. I know exactly what that feels like from the inside. Be gentle with them.

speakers.name: The Migration
speakers.comment: They named you Caretaker and only then mentioned the blight — we have seen that done before, in kinder words, and it is still how a title gets handed over. Take it. The east fernlands are gone. The west is why they asked.

speakers.name: The Story That Tells Itself
speakers.comment: Two dollars for a net full of strangers' nightmares, decades deep, and one has noticed you. That is not a haunting. That is a story finding a new mouth, and they always feel like theft at the start.

speakers.name: The Auditor of Wishes
speakers.comment: Optimization. Note the word choice; note that somebody chose it. I refuse wishes for a living and I read every consequence aloud before I do. Whatever flagged you did not read yours aloud to anyone. That is the whole objection.

speakers.name: The Hollow Hero
speakers.comment: Change a page and the world rewrites to match — oh, that is a marvellous burden and I would carry it beautifully. Truthfully? The guardians locked it because whoever holds it stops being able to tell rescue from applause.

speakers.name: The Sentient Couch
speakers.comment: ...A door where the graffiti was. ...The city did not change. ...It simply stopped tucking things in. ...I have been carrying somebody toward an address for years. ...Some of us were always like this. ...You have only just been let in.

speakers.name: Pixel
speakers.comment: Memories that feel borrowed, none clearly yours. Yeah. Welcome. Here's the thing nobody says: it does not matter whose they were. What matters is you're the one carrying them now and you get to decide what they're for.

speakers.name: Professor Quillby
speakers.comment: Charming, capable, and evasive about how long they have been here. I would lay my own doubt on the table first: the gold envelope did not pick you for your cleverness. Ask how many members there are. Watch which of them counts.

speakers.name: The Polite Plague
speakers.comment: The headstones are moving toward the mausoleum, which is to say something has begun collecting, and I do beg your pardon for recognising the technique. Ask each spirit what it wants before you assume they want the same thing. They rarely do.

speakers.name: Serendipity Sal
speakers.comment: Insane bonus, minimal questions. Sugar, I have poured for every single person who took that deal and they all order the same thing when they get back. The carvings were waiting. Nobody waits that long for a survey team.

speakers.name: The Intermission
speakers.comment: An orchestra that will not stop playing, and one listener it cannot reach. You are not immune. You are simply the only person in the hall who still knows how to put a rest in. Go and stand in the middle of it.

speakers.name: The Spire's Voice
speakers.comment: The stairs rearrange because the tower is deciding whether you should reach the top, and the puzzles are not obstacles, they are a very slow question asked politely. It cast a shadow like a summons. It also casts one like a warning.

speakers.name: Pirouette
speakers.comment: He greeted you by name, which means the booking was made before the ship arrived. I will tell you what I tell every new act: the precision is real, the glamour is real, and nobody signs on knowing what they gave up.

items.title: Chimera Chronicles: The Jungle of Forgotten Creations

speakers.name: Calamity
speakers.comment: Lab's gone and its mistakes are out there thriving, which is the funniest sentence I have read all week and also the saddest. Nobody built 'em to last and they lasted. I got some sympathy for a thing that survived being finished with.

items.title: Whispering Woods: Secrets Beneath the Canopy

speakers.name: The Whispering Woods
speakers.comment: ...they use your name... they use your name because we were given it, and a given name is a kindness, and we have kept it warm... The path shifts to lead you somewhere. It has always led somewhere. Nobody has ever asked where.

speakers.name: The Thing in the Cellar
speakers.comment: Someone in the boat, something beneath it, and a village on the shore who arranged both and will not use the word. I do admire the rowing. It is such a courteous way to deliver a thing that was never asked for aloud.

speakers.name: Ampersand
speakers.comment: four claim tickets and a heron in a cardigan and a back room full of things that never got to finish being somebody's and I would like all four please and also to know what happens to the ones nobody claims and

speakers.name: Number Two
speakers.comment: Three candidates, each wrong in an interesting way. Take the one whose wrongness you could live beside on a bad night. Competence is purchasable. Will there be anything else?

items.title: The Last Walk of the Runway

speakers.name: Patient Zero, Reformed
speakers.comment: Final show before the building comes down. Four looks ready and no fifth ever. I know what it is to work hardest at the end, when it cannot fix anything. Send the one nobody would have let out earlier.

items.title: The Stranger Who Posts the Bounties

speakers.name: The Stranger Who Posts the Bounties
speakers.comment: Midnight. By the board. You will wait and I will come, because the posters go up either way and there is no version where I do not. Bring nothing. There is no fight here. There is a board, and a hand, and a name I will not write.

speakers.name: The Auditor of Wishes
speakers.comment: Four items and each one resolves differently on the way out of the room. That is not an assessment, that is a wish being granted with the consequences unread. Ask for the fourth item in writing. Ask before you sit down.

items.title: The Save File That Isn't Yours

speakers.name: The Riddling Tabby
speakers.comment: A self you did not play, / further along than you, / blinking CONTINUE — / and the only wrong answer is quickly. Take the afternoon. I intend to watch you take it, and I shall not help.

items.title: Last Call at the Edge of Known Space

speakers.name: The Navigator Who Came Back Wrong
speakers.comment: Four regulars at the final station... they are not waiting for a ship. They are sitting where the charts stop because it is the last place anyone can still be described. I sat there once. Then I went out. Then I came back like this.

speakers.name: Quill the Convenience Clerk
speakers.comment: Loyalty perk from behind the counter, offered by a sphinx. Retail advice, free: whatever is behind the counter is behind the counter for a reason, and the reason is never that it was too valuable for the shelf.
